landing.badge: A New Dimension of Curiosity & Learning
landing.subtitle: CuriosityEngine removes the cognitive friction of choice and prompt crafting. It connects ideas into an associative web of knowledge, delivering concise mental models and copy-ready prompts for instant exploration.
landing.features_subtitle: Traditional courses and rigid linear checklists fail. CuriosityEngine guides you through natural knowledge intersections:
landing.f1_desc: Discover ideas that intersect with what you already know. No more artificial barriers or rigid chapters.
landing.f2_desc: Expand and drill deeper into what you recently learned, breaking mechanisms down to their foundational core.
landing.f3_desc: When tired or overwhelmed: zero-friction physical analogies delivering instant 'Aha!' moments.
landing.f4_desc: Capture fleeting thoughts so you never lose them. The engine links them into your knowledge graph and resurfaces them at the right moment.
